lines.beaver: 손님, 인천행 KE905편 운항이 지연되고 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Sir, flight KE905 to Incheon is delayed.
lines.beaver_roman: Sonnim, incheonhaeng KE905pyeon unhangi jiyeondoego itseumnida.
lines.en: How late will it be? I'm worried because I have an appointment.

lines.beaver: 활주로에서 사고가 나서 반나절쯤 늦어질 것 같습니다.
lines.beaver_en: There was an accident on the runway, so about half a day.
lines.beaver_roman: Hwaljuroeseo sagoga naseo bannajeoljjeum neujeojil geot gatseumnida.
lines.learner: 무슨 사고요? 착륙하던 비행기에 문제가 있었어요?
lines.en: What accident? Was there a problem with a landing plane?
lines.roman: Museun sagoyo? Changnyukadeon bihaenggie munjega isseosseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: Two airport vehicles collided with each other.
lines.en: Did a vehicle hit something while backing up?

lines.beaver: 네, 연료 트럭이 부서져 활주로를 치우고 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, a fuel truck was damaged, and we're clearing the runway.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, yeollyo teureogi buseojyeo hwaljuroreul chiugo itseumnida.
lines.learner: 다른 경로는 없나요? 다른 공항을 경유해도 돼요.
lines.en: Is there another route? I can transit through another airport.
lines.roman: Dareun gyeongnoneun eomnayo? Dareun gonghangeul gyeongyuhaedo dwaeyo.

lines.beaver: 경유편은 모두 만석입니다. 버스 편은 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Connecting flights are all full. There is a bus option.
lines.beaver_roman: Gyeongyupyeoneun modu manseogimnida. Beoseu pyeoneun itseumnida.
lines.learner: 육로로 가면 시간이 더 걸리지 않을까요?
lines.roman: Yungnoro gamyeon sigani deo geolliji aneulkkayo?

lines.beaver: 네, 버스로는 일곱 시간쯤 걸려서 추천하지 않습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, the bus takes about seven hours, so I don't recommend it.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, beoseuroneun ilgop siganjjeum geollyeoseo chucheonhaji anseumnida.
lines.en: Then what happens to my checked bags?

lines.beaver: 짐은 안전합니다. 출발 시간은 곧 안내하겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Your bags are safe. We'll announce the departure time soon.
lines.beaver_roman: Jimeun anjeonhamnida. Chulbal siganeun got annaehagetseumnida.
lines.learner: 다시 말해서 비행기가 언제 뜨려는지 모른다는 거죠?
lines.en: In other words, nobody knows when the plane will take off, right?
lines.roman: Dasi malhaeseo bihaenggiga eonje tteuryeoneunji moreundaneun geojyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 오후 다섯 시쯤으로 예상하지만 확정은 아닙니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, we expect around 5 p.m., but it's not confirmed.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, ohu daseot sijjeumeuro yesanghajiman hwakjeongeun animnida.
lines.en: The captain must be tired from waiting so long, too.

lines.beaver_en: The captain will be replaced, and we'll check the fuel again.
lines.learner: 출발 전에 연료 점검 꼼꼼히 부탁드려요.
lines.en: Please check the fuel carefully before departure.
lines.roman: Chulbal jeone yeollyo jeomgeom kkomkkomhi butakdeuryeoyo.

lines.beaver: 불편을 드려 죄송합니다. 식사 쿠폰을 드리겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Sorry for the inconvenience. Here's a meal voucher.
lines.beaver_roman: Bulpyeoneul deuryeo joesonghamnida. Siksa kuponeul deurigetseumnida.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 탑승 안내가 나오면 바로 올게요.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll come right back when boarding is announced.
lines.roman: Gamsahamnida. Tapseung annaega naomyeon baro olgeyo.
